description: The pie chart illustrates the "distribution of data source in the combined trai[ning]" set, as indicated by the partially visible title, and displays a total of 13 distinct slices. There is no separate legend; instead, category labels and their corresponding percentages are positioned outside the pie chart and connected to their respective slices using thin grey leader lines with circular endpoints. Moving clockwise from the largest segment at the top right, the slices include NQ (blue, 31.3%), SCIFACT (an indistinct tiny sliver, 0.1%), ENTFA (yellow, 1.8%), FACTCC (green, 2.6%), ANLI (orange, 4.6%), FEVER (teal, 16.1%), MULTIFC (a tiny light blue sliver with a cut-off percentage), MULTINLI (salmon red, 11.3%), PUBHEALTH (yellow, 0.5%), SCITAIL (green, 1.2%), SNLI (light orange, 15.4%), VITAMINC (cyan, 13.0%), and SUMHUL (light purple, 1.6%). The percentages are not located inside the slices, and none of the segments are visually emphasized through explosion, offsetting, or bolding. Visually, the slices do not appear to be ordered by size in either a clockwise or counterclockwise direction.
